cohort: The study analyzed 62,379 ART singletons and 29,758 ART twins born from 1988 to 2007 in Denmark, Finland, Norway, and Sweden, comparing them with spontaneously conceived singletons and twins.
finding: The perinatal outcomes in children born after ART have improved over the last 20 years, mainly due to the reduction of multiple births.
followup_time: Up to 1 year after birth (for infant death)
